reason: A WeCom smart-robot bridge that provides bidirectional chat with configured DeepSeek Harness agents over a persistent WebSocket connection, including per-chat context, access control, and message handling.

summaries.zh: 通过企业微信智能机器人 WebSocket 网关，将企业微信双向聊天连接到配置的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体。
summaries.en: Connects WeCom smart-robot conversations to configured DeepSeek Harness agents through a bidirectional WebSocket gateway.

capabilities: Connects to the WeCom aibot WebSocket gateway
Receives and sends WeCom chat messages
Maintains per-chat agent sessions and conversational context
Can invoke the configured agent, which may execute host tools
Supports user allowlisting and secret-based authentication
